Neither rejection follows automatically from the revised wording. Applicability under ambiguous assignments and coupled carriers remains unresolved because no current assignment or primitive inventory is supplied.

handoff.residue: The packet reports an earlier assignment mismatch but omits the actual assigned transfer specification. Historical modeled delivery predictions and the identical-request co-presence rival do not establish successful assigned transfer or carrier causality. Additional traceability costs author and reviewer effort; uncertain source support may produce no-opening. Keep these inconvenient limits alongside the unchanged invariant.
handoff.summary: Retain the received revised card exactly. Its sole changed operation strengthens construction_obligation: identify the assigned original connection, substitute carrier and both parents; trace the proposed transfer to those assignments; check that only the assigned connection moves and all parent functions and hard requirements persist; retain source-bound no-opening when that transfer lacks support. Historical feedback documents another-connection substitution; it does not supply the missing assigned primitives. The wording contains no historical notice names, tick schedule or dashboard/ledger requirement. Authored counterexample one: a later assignment specifies different connections/carriers; a supported trace to that later assignment should pass without historical particulars. Rejection for missing those particulars would be application overfit. Authored counterexample two: assignments or coupling are insufficiently specified; deciding that a legitimate representation change transfers another connection may overreject, so retain unresolved applicability and no-opening rather than invent a replacement problem. These are procedural probes, not observed task results. Preserve both named parent functions and every hard requirement. In later authorized applications, check primitive support, link labor and separating replay of original, transfer, broken link, co-presence and each parent alone; matched request outcomes can defeat interaction attribution. No current construction, action replay, held-out gain or observed overrejection is claimed.
